tools.name: federal_contracts
tools.description: Recent U.S. federal contract awards (Department of War daily announcements + USAspending) won by publicly traded companies, newest first. Each award includes its size as a % of the winner's market cap and the stock move since the announcement. Costs 1 credit (free tier: 25 calls/day).

tools.name: contract_shocks
tools.description: Federal awards that are large relative to the winning company's size: award value ÷ market cap ≥ min_pct. A $500M award means little to a $200B prime but a lot to a $5B company. Costs 1 credit (free tier: 25 calls/day).

tools.name: contract_recipients
tools.description: Public companies ranked by total federal awards in the window relative to their market cap, with award count, largest award and stock move since the first award. Costs 1 credit (free tier: 25 calls/day).

tools.name: stock_dna
tools.description: The Faro DNA score (0–100) of a U.S. stock and its 7 pillars: track record, revenue, quality, cash, price, balance sheet and federal-money flow. Levels: fuerte (strong), prometedor (promising), mixto (mixed), debil (weak). Costs 1 credit (free tier: 25 calls/day).

tools.name: rank_dna
tools.description: Ranking of 340+ U.S. stocks by Faro DNA score, filterable by minimum score, level and sector. Costs 1 credit (free tier: 25 calls/day).

tools.name: quality_dips
tools.description: Stocks with 15+ years of strong history (≥7%/yr, ≥60% positive years) now 3–25% below their all-time high. Includes 1/3/5/7/10-year total returns, 10- and 20-year CAGR, volatility, dividend yield and DNA score. Costs 1 credit (free tier: 25 calls/day).

tools.name: ipo_radar
tools.description: U.S. IPOs of the last 13 months with return since IPO, DNA score, revenue growth and lock-up date; plus upcoming IPOs. Costs 1 credit (free tier: 25 calls/day).

tools.name: stock_profile
tools.description: One call: DNA score and pillars, federal contracts of the last 60 days, contract-size stats, price vs 52-week high, long-term returns and IPO data when applicable. Costs 1 credit (free tier: 25 calls/day).

tools.name: account
tools.description: Credits left on your API key (or free calls left today without a key) and how to buy more. Free; does not use a credit.
